caption:
Keyboard users include people with motor disabilities, screen reader users and plenty of power users.

The usual problems:
Clickable divs that Tab skips.
outline: none with no replacement, so focus is invisible.
Custom dropdowns that ignore arrow keys.

Most are fixed by using real elements: <button>, <input>, <select>, <form>.

Five-minute test, no tools needed. Try it on your project tonight.

Source: WCAG 2.2, Keyboard (2.1.1) and Focus Visible (2.4.7).

For Best Frontend Resources visit https://allahabadi.dev created by Frontend Master

altText:
Unplug your mouse and try to fill your own signup form.

Can you reach every field with Tab? Submit with Enter? See where focus is?

If not, some of your users can't sign up.
